annotations.title: Find plans by company name, EIN, state, size, recordkeeper or plan type

description:
Find plans. Give at least one of `name`, `ein`, `state` or `recordkeeper`; the other filters narrow
the list. Each result is a short summary: call `get_plan` with its `ein` and `pn` for the profile.

With `name`, results are ordered by match score, then size; without it, largest plans first. Plans
that ended are hidden unless `include_ended=true`. Paging stops at offset 500: narrow the filters to
see more.

Price: $0.01 per call, paid in USDC on Base (mainnet) with x402 (MCP transport). Without payment the tool returns the payment requirements. Errors and empty results aren't charged.

Same data as GET /search of the Plan Data API.

ein.description: Sponsor EIN (9 digits, dashes allowed). Lists every retirement plan under it.
ein.title: Ein

filer_size.description: large = files Schedule H (generally 100+ participants; has providers and fees); small = 5500-SF or Schedule I.
filer_size.title: Filer Size

include_ended.description: Include plans that are terminated, merged into another plan, or stopped filing. Off by default.
include_ended.title: Include Ended

max_assets.description: Maximum end-of-year net assets in dollars.
max_assets.title: Max Assets

min_assets.description: Minimum end-of-year net assets in dollars, latest plan year.
min_assets.title: Min Assets

name.description: Company or plan name, as you know it. Fuzzy: typos, missing suffixes (Inc, LLC), DBA names and former names all match, and the last word can be a prefix ("starb"). Results come best match first with a `match` score.
name.title: Name

plan_type.description: Plan type: 401k, 403b, cash_balance, db_and_dc, defined_benefit, esop, ira_based, money_purchase, other_dc, profit_sharing, stock_bonus, target_benefit, type_not_coded, db, dc. `dc` = any defined contribution plan, `db` = any defined benefit plan.
plan_type.title: Plan Type

recordkeeper.description: Recordkeeper, any brand old or new ("Empower", "Great-West", "Fidelity"). Matched to the firm's family, so Great-West and Prudential filings count as Empower. Only plans that filed a Schedule C can match. `meta.query.recordkeeper` shows what it resolved to.
recordkeeper.title: Recordkeeper

state.description: Two-letter state of the sponsor's address, e.g. TX.
state.title: State
